checks.explanation: Chinese open-weight models (DeepSeek and others) have gained substantial global adoption, especially in emerging markets, but no source confirms 'the majority of the world' now runs on Chinese rather than American AI models.

Consistent with current trends: near-term military robotics gains through 2025-2026 have come primarily from drones, air, and maritime autonomous systems (as seen extensively in Ukraine), while humanoid robots remain far from battlefield-ready.
The predicted 6-7 year window hasn't elapsed and no savant-level domain-specific AI superintelligence has been demonstrated yet.
The predicted 5-10 year window hasn't elapsed and no AI system has demonstrated recursive self-improvement.
